children: Nate said on X that without token code locks and client-side issuance limits, daily launches on the platform could reach 100,000, increasing bot activity and making it harder for ordinary users to screen new assets. According to Odaily, the team plans to add asset discovery filters based on factors such as whale holdings, asset age, and antifragility, while also aggregating liquidity and capital flows toward stronger and more distinctive assets within the ecosystem.

Nate added that the team has not found major issues with trading pairs, but has prepared new risk-control parameters and will quickly activate restrictions if coordinated manipulation is found behind pump-and-dump activity.

title: Nate Says Token Launch Limits Could Reach 100,000 Per Day Without Code Locks
